title: No label left behind: a unified surface defect detection model for all supervision regimes (SuperSimpleNet)
mechanism: One discriminative model trainable in unsupervised, weak, mixed and full supervision, with feature-space synthetic anomalies plus segmentation and classification heads.
adaptation: Mixed supervision: 478 pixel-labelled cells + pool cells tagged image-level clean by the house ensemble; binary defect map (crack OR inactive OR material) used as an extra ensemble member for recall.
min_experiment: Arm PF ensemble + SuperSimpleNet member vs baseline PF ensemble; metric CV relR@2 at relP@2 >= 0.90; kill if relR@2 gain < +0.02. About 10 GPU-h.
evidence: R: SOTA across four supervision regimes on four industrial benchmarks; < 10 ms inference.

alt_notes.adaptation: Mixed supervision: 478 pixel-labelled cells + pool cells tagged clean by the house ensemble; binary defect map (crack OR inactive OR material) as an ensemble member and as the AD-family baseline in the benchmark.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Train once per supervision regime; report pixel AUROC, AU-PRO, SegF1 for crack (2 px tolerance) and inactive on test and E1; as fusion arm with PF ensemble kill if inactive IoU gain < +0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark baseline across supervision levels (full masks, ELPV-style image labels, mixed); for scores only its synthetic-anomaly stage as a regulariser on pool cells.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark run: train on our splits at each supervision level, report crack / inactive AP and relF1@2 on test and E1; no kill.

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark baseline that can consume ELPV image labels and the unlabelled pool under the same protocol; run on 1-channel 512 px cells with crack/inactive as anomaly maps.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Run as a benchmark entry on clean-49 and E1 with mixed supervision (BenchmarkEL masks + ELPV labels). Compare to house 5-seed on crack relF1@2 and inactive IoU. No kill line; reported as a baseline. ~6 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark: binary crack and binary inactive models in all four regimes at 512 px, ELPV image labels for the weak regime. Score: borrow latent Perlin noise on labelled background as a regulariser on the U-Net++ encoder to suppress decoys (scuffs, grain boundaries).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: official code, binary crack/inactive, full and weak regimes; baseline: house; metric: crack AP, relF1@2, E1 relF1@2; benchmark row regardless; score kill if adding it as 6th ensemble member gives < +0.01 relF1@2.
